title: Preparación del primer caso productivo E0→E72
purpose: Registrar el post aprobado seleccionado y el control posterior preparado para capturar E0 únicamente después de que Meta confirme la publicación real.
author: Manus AI (CGO)

scope.mode: read-only discovery plus one-shot post-publication control

approved_case.caption: 🧚‍♀️🍗🎬😂 #KiriUSM #MemesUSM #UniverseSentMe
approved_case.selection_rule: Earliest future approved post returned by Meta scheduled_posts and matched to the local Publication_Log.

post_publication_control.schedule_name: USM: capturar E0 del próximo post aprobado
post_publication_control.safe_behavior: Read Meta only; if is_published=false, write nothing and report E0_PENDING; if is_published=true, invoke the E0 adapter, persist raw and validate the ledger.

execution_state.next_required_evidence: Meta response with is_published=true and created_time for the selected Meta_Post_ID.
